recipes.title: Warm Ground Clove, Cinnamon & Ginger Chai Oats
recipes.summary: Fragrant caffeine-free spiced rolled oats gently warmed with cinnamon, ginger, a subtle pinch of ground clove, milk, and sliced ripe banana.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, cinnamon, ginger, and 1/8 tsp ground clove 6 to 7 minutes until velvety soft.
Spoon into a warm bowl.
Top with sweet sliced ripe banana and enjoy steaming.
tips: Ground clove is richly concentrated—1/8 teaspoon perfumes an entire bowl warmly without overpowering.
Naturally sweet from ripe banana with zero added syrup needed.

recipes.title: Warm Ground Clove & Orange Stewed Pears with Yogurt
recipes.summary: Spoon-soft diced pears gently simmered with sweet orange juice, honey, cinnamon, and fragrant ground clove, served warm over cool Greek yogurt.
steps: Simmer diced pears, fresh orange juice, honey, cinnamon, and ground clove 8 to 10 minutes until tender and lightly syrupy.
Spoon plain Greek yogurt into two bowls.
Pile the fragrant warm pears and orange-clove syrup right over the cool yogurt.
tips: Orange and clove are one of the most beloved aromatic pairings in winter cooking.
Soft stewed fruit is soothing and easy to eat.

recipes.title: Tender Pumpkin, Oat & Ground Clove Skillet Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy whole-grain oat and real pumpkin pancakes perfumed with cinnamon and ground clove, served warm with yogurt or maple drizzle.
steps: Blend rolled oats, pumpkin puree, milk, eggs, baking powder, cinnamon, and ground clove 35 seconds until smooth.
Pour 1/4-cup rounds onto a lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until puffed and golden; serve warm.
tips: Real pumpkin keeps blender oat pancakes extraordinarily moist and soft.
Ground clove supplies the authentic nostalgic spice behind classic pumpkin pie.

recipes.title: Cozy Gingerbread Clove & Maple Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead creamy oats scented like warm gingerbread with oat milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, ginger, cinnamon, and a gentle pinch of ground clove.
steps: Stir rolled oats, oat milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, ginger, cinnamon, and 1/8 tsp ground clove evenly in two jars.
Cover and chill overnight until velvety thick.
Enjoy chilled or gently warmed in the morning.
tips: Using pure maple syrup gives cozy bakery warmth without heavy refined sugar.
Zero morning effort—just grab a spoon.

recipes.title: Warm Clove-Spiced Skillet Apples over Ricotta Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with cool part-skim ricotta and piled with tender diced apples gently softened in olive oil, cinnamon, and a pinch of ground clove.
steps: Warm diced apple with olive oil, 2 tbsp water, cinnamon, and ground clove in a small skillet 5 to 6 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Spread warm toasted whole-grain bread thickly with cool part-skim ricotta.
Spoon the aromatic soft spiced apples across both slices and serve warm.
tips: Soft cooked apples are far gentler to bite than crisp raw wedges on toast.
High in morning protein with inviting bakery aroma.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Red Lentil & Clove Soup
recipes.summary: Rich dairy-free autumn soup simmering butternut squash, protein-rich red lentils, sweet onion, ginger, and a warming pinch of ground clove.
steps: Soften onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in grated ginger and ground clove 30 seconds until warmly aromatic.
Add cubed squash, rinsed red lentils, and vegetable broth; simmer 15 minutes until completely fork-tender.
Blend silky smooth with an immersion blender and serve hot.
tips: A tiny 1/8 tsp pinch of ground clove adds slow-simmered restaurant depth to squash soup.
Smooth, nourishing, and easy to swallow.

recipes.title: Warm Garam-Style Clove, Cumin & Chickpea Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Fragrant mild Indian-style skillet simmering chickpeas, diced tomato, baby spinach, cumin, cinnamon, and ground clove over fluffy basmati rice.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked basmati or brown rice

steps: Warm oil over medium-low heat and bloom ground cumin and 1/8 tsp ground clove 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add rinsed chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, and 1/4 cup water and simmer gently 8 minutes.
Fold in baby spinach until wilted and spoon generously over warm rice.
tips: Clove and cumin are cornerstones of mild aromatic garam masala—zero chili burn, big cozy flavor.
Top with cool plain yogurt if desired.

recipes.title: Classic French-Style Clove, Onion & White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: Inspired by French oignon pique (clove-studded onion): sweet caramelized onions simmered with creamy white beans, thyme, vegetable broth, and a pinch of ground clove.
steps: Soften thinly sliced onion gently in olive oil 8 minutes until sweet and golden, then stir in dried thyme and ground clove 30 seconds.
Add rinsed cannellini beans and vegetable broth and simmer gently 10 minutes.
Mash a cup of white beans softly against the pot for velvety richness and ladle warm.
tips: French chefs traditionally stud an onion with clove for soup stocks—a tiny 1/8 tsp pinch of ground clove gives that unmistakable old-world richness fast.
Serve with toasted whole-grain bread.

recipes.title: Warm Clove-Balsamic Beet, Orange & Quinoa Salad
recipes.summary: Jewel-red steamed beets, sweet orange segments, fluffy quinoa, and baby spinach tossed in balsamic olive oil dressing scented gently with ground clove.
steps: Shake balsamic vinegar, extra-virgin olive oil, a tiny 1/16 tsp pinch of ground clove, and a pinch of salt in a jar.
Arrange baby spinach, cooked quinoa, steamed diced beets, and sweet orange segments in a bowl.
Drizzle generously with the aromatic clove-balsamic vinaigrette and toss lightly.
tips: Pickled and roasted beets have been paired with clove across Europe for centuries—this no-cook salad captures that harmony cleanly.
Add crumbled goat cheese or walnuts for extra staying power.

recipes.title: Fragrant Clove, Ginger & Poached Chicken Rice Noodle Bowl
recipes.summary: Restorative pho-style clear broth infused with fresh ginger, cinnamon, and ground clove, brimming with soft rice noodles, spinach, and tender poached chicken.
steps: Simmer chicken broth, grated ginger, cinnamon, and 1/8 tsp ground clove 6 minutes until wonderfully fragrant.
Add thin rice noodles and cook 3 minutes until silky soft.
Fold in shredded poached chicken and baby spinach 1 minute until wilted and ladle warm into deep bowls.
tips: Clove is one of the essential warming spices that gives authentic Vietnamese noodle soups their restorative aroma.
Brighten each bowl with fresh lime juice and herbs.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Maple & Ground Clove Glazed Salmon
recipes.summary: Moist oven-baked salmon brushed with a bright sweet-spiced glaze of orange juice, maple syrup, olive oil, and ground clove beside roasted carrots.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss carrot slices with 1 tbsp olive oil on a parchment-lined sheet pan and roast 8 minutes first.
Whisk orange juice, maple syrup, remaining olive oil, and 1/8 tsp ground clove; nestle salmon onto the pan and brush generously.
Bake 12 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly and carrots are sweet and tender.
tips: Delivers festive holiday orange-clove aroma on a quick 20-minute weeknight omega-3 dinner.
Serve over warm jasmine rice or quinoa.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Baharat-Style Clove & Cinnamon Chicken
recipes.summary: Juicy sheet-pan chicken thighs and cubed sweet potatoes roasted with olive oil, cumin, cinnamon, black pepper, and aromatic ground clove.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; stir olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, cinnamon, and ground clove into a fragrant rub.
Toss chicken thighs and sweet potato cubes with the spice oil on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 22 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and sweet potatoes are golden and fork-tender.
tips: Echoes warm Levantine baharat seasoning with zero chili heat.
Serve with cool plain Greek yogurt and steamed greens.

recipes.title: Orchard Apple Cider & Ground Clove Pork Medallions
recipes.summary: Lean pork tenderloin medallions pan-cooked with thinly sliced apples, pure apple cider, thyme, and a cozy pinch of ground clove.

ingredient_details.item: unsweetened apple cider or chicken broth

steps: Sear pork medallions in olive oil 3 minutes per side until 145 F, then rest on a warm plate.
Saute peeled apple slices with thyme and ground clove 2 minutes in the same skillet, pour in cider or broth, cover, and simmer 5 minutes until apples turn soft.
Return pork medallions and juices 1 minute to coat and serve warm.
tips: Gives classic clove-studded roast ham warmth with lean, low-sodium pork tenderloin.
Pair with mashed potatoes or steamed green beans.

recipes.title: Greek Stifado-Style Lentil, Tomato & Ground Clove Stew
recipes.summary: Traditional Greek sweet-onion and tomato stew made plant-based with hearty brown lentils, balsamic vinegar, cinnamon, olive oil, and fragrant ground clove.
equipment: Dutch oven or wide pot with lid
steps: Soften sweet onion petals gently in olive oil 6 minutes until golden, then stir in ground cinnamon and 1/8 tsp ground clove 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, cooked lentils, and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer gently 14 minutes.
Ladle the glossy sweet-savory stew over warm rice, mashed potatoes, or soft orzo.
tips: Stifado is Greece's signature clove-and-cinnamon onion stew—comforting, rich, and wonderfully soft.
Completely plant-based and fiber-rich.

recipes.title: Mild Coconut, Cauliflower & Clove Vegetable Korma
recipes.summary: Velvety mild Indian korma simmering tender cauliflower, sweet peas, and chickpeas in light coconut milk scented with ginger, cumin, and ground clove.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp oil over medium-low heat and bloom grated ginger, cumin, and 1/8 tsp ground clove 30 seconds.
Add small cauliflower florets, chickpeas, light coconut milk, and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 14 minutes until cauliflower is fork-tender.
Fold in frozen green peas 2 minutes until bright and warm, serving over fluffy basmati rice.
tips: Korma focuses on warm sweet aromatics like clove and coconut rather than hot chili peppers.
Soft, dairy-free, and soothing.

recipes.title: Cozy Spiced Chai, Banana & Ground Clove Oat Smoothie
recipes.summary: Caffeine-free creamy masala-chai smoothie blending frozen banana, rolled oats, oat milk, cinnamon, ginger, and a warming pinch of ground clove.
steps: Place oat milk, rolled oats, frozen banana, cinnamon, ginger, and 1/16 tsp ground clove in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until frothy, silky, and warmly spiced.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: With raw spices in cold smoothies, 1/16 tsp ground clove gives the exact sweet cafe-chai note without bitterness.
Naturally dairy-free and sustaining.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Spice, Yogurt & Ground Clove Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety orange autumn shake blending pure pumpkin puree, Greek yogurt, milk, frozen banana, cinnamon, and a fragrant pinch of ground clove.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, pumpkin puree, frozen banana, cinnamon, and 1/16 tsp ground clove in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until creamy golden and silky smooth.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Clove is the secret aroma that makes pumpkin smoothies taste unmistakably like fresh-baked pie.
High in protein and gentle dietary fiber.

recipes.title: Spiced Date, Ginger & Ground Clove Almond Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rich dairy-free gingerbread-inspired smoothie pairing Medjool dates, almond butter, frozen banana, almond milk, ginger, and ground clove.
steps: Add almond milk, frozen banana, pitted dates, almond butter, ginger, and 1/16 tsp ground clove to a blender.
Blend 55 seconds until caramel-smooth and frothy.
Pour into a tall glass and enjoy right away.
tips: Sweet caramel dates mimic molasses naturally without refined syrups.
Dairy-free and sustaining.

recipes.title: Spiced Pear, Vanilla & Ground Clove Velvet Smoothie
recipes.summary: Silky winter orchard smoothie blending peeled ripe pear, Greek yogurt, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and a gentle pinch of ground clove.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, diced peeled pear, vanilla, cinnamon, 1/16 tsp ground clove, and 4 ice cubes in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until pale ivory, airy, and velvety smooth.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Ripe pear and clove bring cozy poached-pear aroma to a 5-minute cold breakfast glass.
Gentle, hydrating, and high in protein.

recipes.title: Dark Cherry, Cocoa & Ground Clove Winter Smoothie
recipes.summary: Antioxidant-rich European spiced chocolate smoothie uniting frozen dark cherries, cocoa powder, banana, oat milk, and a whisper of ground clove.
steps: Place oat milk, frozen cherries, frozen banana, cocoa powder, orange zest, and 1/16 tsp ground clove in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until thick, glossy, and deeply flavorful.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: Orange zest, dark cherry, cocoa, and clove recall warm European holiday treats in a nourishing plant-based shake.
Zero added sweetener needed.

recipes.title: Mulled Orchard Apple Cider & Ground Clove Press
recipes.summary: Classic mulled unfiltered apple cider steeped gently with ground clove, cinnamon, and orange peel, strained spotless and poured over ice or warm.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange peel plus 2 tbsp juice

steps: Warm apple cider gently with orange peel, cinnamon, and 1/8 tsp ground clove 4 minutes without boiling, then steep 2 minutes off heat.
Strain through a fine paper filter or tea sieve and stir in fresh orange juice.
Serve cold over tall glasses of ice—or sip warm in mugs.
tips: Straining through a fine filter leaves silky, clear mulled cider with zero spice sediment.
Naturally sweet and completely caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Ruby Cranberry, Sweet Orange & Ground Clove Spritz
recipes.summary: Festive alcohol-free harvest press uniting freshly squeezed orange juice, pure cranberry juice, a strained clove infusion, and sparkling water.
steps: Steep 1/8 tsp ground clove in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, then strain cleanly through a fine sieve or coffee filter.
Divide the fragrant clove infusion, orange juice, and cranberry juice between two ice-filled glasses.
Top with sparkling water, stir lightly, and serve crisp.
tips: Fresh sweet orange juice balances brisk unsweetened cranberry naturally.
Tastes celebratory any season with zero alcohol or added sugar.

recipes.title: Caribbean Sorrel-Style Hibiscus, Ginger & Clove Press
recipes.summary: Beloved Caribbean chilled ruby hibiscus punch steeped with fresh ginger, orange peel, honey, and aromatic ground clove.

ingredient_details.item: dried hibiscus petals (or 2 hibiscus tea bags)

steps: Steep hibiscus, ginger slices, orange peel, and 1/8 tsp ground clove in 2 cups hot water covered 8 minutes.
Strain cleanly through a fine mesh or paper filter and stir honey in while warm.
Chill well and pour over tall glasses of ice.
tips: Jamaican and Trinidadian sorrel drink is famous for its bright ginger-clove-hibiscus sparkle.
100% caffeine-free and rich in ruby polyphenols.

recipes.title: Chilled Citrus, Honey & Steeped Ground Clove Tonic
recipes.summary: Soothing amber herbal citrus press pouring freshly steeped strained ground clove infusion over ice with sweet orange, lemon, and honey.
steps: Steep 1/8 tsp ground clove in 2/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain through a fine coffee filter or tea sieve.
Dissolve honey into the warm clear clove brew and stir in orange juice and lemon juice.
Pour over ice cubes (or enjoy steaming warm).
tips: Clear, crisp, and soothing on the throat with zero caffeine.
Keep ground clove at 1/8 tsp for pleasant warmth.

recipes.title: Chilled Pear, Ginger & Steeped Clove Orchard Press
recipes.summary: Delicate pure pear juice layered with a clear steeped clove-ginger infusion and fresh lemon juice over ice.
steps: Steep 1/8 tsp ground clove and ginger slices in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the strained aromatic infusion, pure pear juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and serve cold.
tips: Mellow pear softens clove and ginger into a calm, refined orchard cooler.
No added sugar required.

recipes.title: Warm Ground Clove, Cinnamon, Banana & Blueberry Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Aromatic spiced rolled oats cooked with mashed ripe banana, cinnamon, a warm pinch of ground clove, wild blueberries, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, mashed banana, ground cinnamon, and ground clove 6 to 7 minutes until silky and fragrant.
Spoon into warm bowls and top with fresh blueberries.
Drizzle gently with cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
tips: A gentle 1/8 tsp of ground clove gives cozy autumn spice without overpowering sweetness.
Soft and naturally sweet.

recipes.title: Masala Chai Clove, Black Tea, Orange & Walnut Oil Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Fragrant quick pearl barley simmered in mild black tea and milk with grated ginger, ground clove, cinnamon, orange zest, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Simmer quick barley, milk, mild black tea, grated ginger, cinnamon, and ground clove 10 to 12 minutes until tender.
Fold in fresh orange zest off the heat and spoon into warm bowls.
Finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Warming chai spices fill the kitchen with inviting morning aroma.
Decaf black tea works seamlessly.

recipes.title: Clove-Spiced Warm Dark Cherries, Cacao & Olive Oil Ricotta
recipes.summary: Sweet dark cherries softly simmered with orange juice, cinnamon, and a warm pinch of clove over whipped ricotta with shaved 70% dark chocolate and olive oil.
steps: Simmer halved dark cherries, orange juice, cinnamon, and ground clove 5 to 6 minutes until glossy and soft.
Fluff ricotta into two bowls and spoon the warm clove-spiced cherries over top.
Scatter finely shaved dark chocolate and drizzle gently with fruity olive oil.
tips: Clove highlights the deep winey richness of dark sweet cherries.
High-protein and refined-sugar free.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove, Coffee, Anise Seed & Banana Soft Griddle Cakes
recipes.summary: Tender gingerbread-mocha oat griddle cakes scented with ground clove, anise seed, brewed coffee, mashed banana, and sunflower oil.
steps: Whisk mashed banana, eggs, quick oats, cooled coffee, ground clove, anise seed, cinnamon, and half the sunflower oil.
Brush a warm skillet with remaining sunflower oil and cook small tender cakes 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with plain yogurt or sliced fruit.
tips: Tastes like soft holiday spice cakes ready in under 15 minutes.
Gentle, moist crumb.

recipes.title: Golden Clove, Saffron, Cantaloupe & Pumpkin Seed Oil Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead creamy overnight oats scented with golden saffron and a subtle pinch of clove, topped with sweet cantaloupe, raspberries, and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Steep saffron in warm milk 2 minutes, then stir with cold milk, rolled oats, and a gentle pinch of ground clove; refrigerate overnight.
Top golden chilled oats in the morning with ripe cantaloupe cubes and fresh raspberries.
Finish with a silky swirl of roasted pumpkin seed oil.
tips: Zero cooking required in the morning.
Subtle warm spice complements nutty pumpkin seed oil.

recipes.title: Fragrant Clove, Turmeric, Cumin & Celery Red Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: Silky Indian-inspired red lentil puree gently bloomed with ground clove, turmeric, cumin, grated ginger, black pepper, celery stalk, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk and grated ginger in olive oil 3 minutes, then bloom turmeric, cumin, ground clove, and black pepper 20 seconds.
Add rinsed red lentils and broth; simmer gently 15 minutes until creamy.
Blend silky smooth and serve warm.
tips: Just 1/8 tsp ground clove gives everyday lentil soup rich garam-masala depth.
Ultra-smooth and soothing.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove, Cinnamon, Poached Chicken & Red Grape Barley Pilaf
recipes.summary: Warm Levantine grain bowl tossing cooked pearl barley, shredded chicken, halved red grapes, finely diced celery stalk, clove, cinnamon, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk in olive oil 3 minutes, then bloom cinnamon and ground clove 20 seconds.
Add cooked barley, shredded chicken, halved red grapes, and broth; warm gently 4 minutes until aromatic and moist.
Spoon into warm bowls and serve.
tips: Warm Arabic-style spice profile using gentle sweet spices rather than fiery chilies.
Tender and comforting.

recipes.title: Velvety Clove, Sweet Orange, Ginger & Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth autumn-gold squash soup gently spiced with a pinch of clove, grated fresh ginger, cinnamon, sweet orange juice, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Soften diced squash and grated ginger in olive oil 3 minutes, then stir in cinnamon and ground clove.
Add vegetable broth and simmer gently 14 minutes until completely soft, then blend silky smooth.
Stir in fresh orange juice off the heat and finish bowls with roasted pumpkin seed oil.
tips: Clove, orange, and sweet squash taste deeply cozy without any heavy cream.
Glides down smoothly.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove & Black Tea-Poached Salmon with Orange & Celery
recipes.summary: Moist salmon fillets gently poached in mild black tea scented with whole cloves and orange peel, flaked cool over thinly sliced celery stalk and barley.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in poaching tea and discarded

steps: Bring mild black tea, whole cloves, and a strip of orange peel to a gentle simmer 3 minutes.
Slide salmon fillets into the fragrant tea, cover, and gently poach 9 minutes until flaky, then lift out (discarding cloves).
Serve salmon over pearl barley, thinly sliced celery stalk, and orange segments drizzled with olive oil.
tips: Steeping whole cloves in the poaching liquid yields delicate aromatic perfume without biting into spice.
Tender omega-3 lunch.

recipes.title: Warm Clove-Spiced Chickpeas, Cherry, Sumac & Walnut Oil Bowl
recipes.summary: Savory-sweet Mediterranean chickpeas warmed with a subtle pinch of clove, cumin, halved dark cherries, tangy ruby sumac, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Warm olive oil with cumin and a gentle pinch of ground clove 20 seconds.
Add soft chickpeas, halved cherries, and 3 tbsp water; warm gently 5 minutes until glossy.
Plate warm, dust with tangy sumac, and finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Clove links earthy cumin and juicy cherries harmoniously.
Quick plant-forward midday meal.

recipes.title: Aromatic Clove, Saffron, Cinnamon & Cumin Gentle Chicken Biryani Bowl
recipes.summary: Mild home-style aromatic chicken simmered with ground clove, cinnamon, cumin, golden saffron, celery stalk, cilantro, and rice bran oil over soft rice.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk in rice bran oil 3 minutes, then bloom ground clove, cinnamon, and cumin 20 seconds.
Add diced chicken, saffron broth, and remaining broth; cover and simmer gently 11 minutes until tender.
Spoon aromatic golden chicken over warm soft rice and top with fresh cilantro.
tips: Delivers beloved biryani fragrance without fiery chilies or tough textures.
One-skillet weeknight warmth.

recipes.title: Velvety Clove, Dark Chocolate, Cherry & Cinnamon Turkey Bowl
recipes.summary: Rich mild mole-inspired ground turkey gently simmered with halved dark cherries, cinnamon, a pinch of clove, 70% dark chocolate, and sunflower oil.
steps: Cook finely crumbled lean ground turkey in sunflower oil 5 minutes, then bloom cumin, cinnamon, and ground clove.
Add chicken broth and halved dark cherries, simmering gently 6 minutes.
Turn heat to low and melt in finely chopped dark chocolate until velvety; serve over warm barley or rice.
tips: Clove is a classic authentic spice in Mexican mole that makes cacao and cherry sing.
Soft and easy to chew.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove, Sweet Orange, Fennel Seed & Ginger Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Flaky baked salmon glazed with fresh orange juice, grated ginger, finely crushed fennel seed, a tiny pinch of clove, and olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange juice plus 1/2 tsp zest

steps: Whisk olive oil, fresh orange juice, grated ginger, crushed fennel seed, and a gentle pinch of ground clove.
Place salmon fillets in a baking dish, spoon glaze over top, and bake at 375°F for 12 to 13 minutes until flaky.
Garnish with fresh orange zest and serve warm over cooked barley.
tips: A whisper of clove turns citrus-ginger fish glaze deeply warming and aromatic.
Moist and delicate.

recipes.title: Warm Clove, Turmeric, Nigella Seed & Sweet Potato Chickpea Stew
recipes.summary: Comforting golden plant-forward stew simmering small-diced sweet potato and soft chickpeas with turmeric, ground clove, cumin, nigella seed, and olive oil.
steps: Warm olive oil and gently bloom turmeric, cumin, ground clove, and black pepper 20 seconds.
Add small-diced sweet potato, soft chickpeas, and vegetable broth; cover and simmer 14 minutes until fork-tender.
Serve warm topped with toasted nigella seeds.
tips: Sweet potato softens into a rich golden gravy infused with gentle warming spices.
Nourishing and tender.

recipes.title: Autumn Clove, Fresh Sage, Red Grape & White Bean Barley Pot
recipes.summary: Cozy vegetarian skillet simmering creamy cannellini beans, cooked pearl barley, minced sage, halved red grapes, a whisper of clove, and walnut oil.
steps: Warm minced sage and a tiny pinch of ground clove in olive oil 30 seconds.
Add white beans, cooked pearl barley, broth, black pepper, and halved red grapes; simmer gently 9 minutes until creamy.
Plate warm and finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Subtle warm clove ties sage, white beans, and burst grapes together effortlessly.
Soft texture throughout.

recipes.title: Cozy Spiced Clove, Cinnamon, Ginger & Banana Chai Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy spiced smoothie uniting frozen banana, cinnamon, grated fresh ginger, a warm pinch of clove, chilled mild black tea, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Blend chilled mild black tea, oat milk, frozen banana, cinnamon, grated ginger, and a pinch of ground clove until silky.
Add cold-pressed flaxseed oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy immediately.
tips: Classic warming chai flavor in a smooth, naturally sweet glass.
Decaf black tea works cleanly.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove, Dark Cherry, 70% Cacao & Walnut Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Rich dark-berry cacao blend pairing frozen dark cherries, finely chopped 70% dark chocolate, cinnamon, a pinch of clove, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Blend milk, frozen dark cherries, finely chopped dark chocolate, cinnamon, and a gentle pinch of ground clove until smooth.
Add cold-pressed walnut oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Serve cold right away.
tips: A tiny pinch of clove deepens cherry-chocolate aroma like European spiced truffles.
Lush and velvety.

recipes.title: Autumn Clove, Sweet Orange, Cantaloupe & Turmeric Smoothie
recipes.summary: Glowing golden smoothie uniting peeled sweet orange, chilled cantaloupe, turmeric, a pinch of clove, black pepper, yogurt, and sunflower oil.
steps: Blend peeled sweet orange, chilled cantaloupe, Greek yogurt, turmeric, a pinch of ground clove, and black pepper until smooth.
Add cold-pressed sunflower oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour chilled and serve immediately.
tips: Pomander-inspired orange and clove flavor made bright and creamy.
Zero refined sugar.

recipes.title: Cafe Spiced Clove, Iced Coffee, Anise Seed & Barley Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety spiced coffee shake blending chilled coffee, soft cooked barley, frozen banana, ground anise seed, a pinch of clove, and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Blend chilled coffee, oat milk, soft cooked barley, frozen banana, anise seed, and a pinch of ground clove 50 seconds.
Add roasted pumpkin seed oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Inspired by traditional Mexican cafe de olla with soothing whole-grain creaminess.
Use decaf coffee if preferred.

recipes.title: Mulled-Berry Clove, Blueberry, Purple Grape & Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep violet smoothie uniting wild blueberries, frozen purple grapes, cinnamon, a pinch of clove, yogurt, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend cold water, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, frozen purple grapes, cinnamon, and a gentle pinch of clove until velvety.
Add fruity extra-virgin olive oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy immediately.
tips: Tastes like cool alcohol-free spiced vineyard fruit in a creamy glass.
Polyphenol-rich and smooth.

recipes.title: Pomander Clove, Fresh Orange, Cinnamon & Ginger Pressed Tonic
recipes.summary: Fragrant chilled citrus tonic infusing whole cloves and cinnamon in a splash of hot water, blended into fresh-squeezed orange juice and grated ginger.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water and strained

steps: Steep whole cloves in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Stir chilled clove infusion with fresh orange juice, grated ginger, and cinnamon.
Pass through a fine-mesh sieve and pour cold.
tips: Steeping whole cloves gives pure warm fragrance with zero gritty sediment.
Bright and naturally sweet.

recipes.title: Chilled Mulled Clove, Red Grape, Black Tea & Anise Cooler
recipes.summary: Ruby alcohol-free chilled mulled press combining mild black tea steeped with clove and anise seed with fresh strained red grape juice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with black tea and strained

steps: Steep mild black tea with whole cloves and crushed anise seed 3 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend seedless red grapes with 1/2 cup chilled spiced tea 30 seconds, then press smoothly through a fine sieve.
Stir back into remaining chilled tea and serve cold.
tips: Festive warming spice flavor served silky and cool.
Decaf black tea works wonderfully.

recipes.title: Spiced Clove, Dark Cherry, Raspberry & Lemon Balm Ruby Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-dark pressed berry tonic blending chilled clove tea with fresh dark cherries, raspberries, and calming lemon balm leaves.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep whole cloves in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled clove tea, pitted cherries, raspberries, and fresh lemon balm leaves 30 seconds.
Strain thoroughly through a fine-mesh sieve to remove seeds and pour cold.
tips: Smooth, seedless, and warmly fragrant.
Natural fruit sugars keep it balanced.

recipes.title: Golden Clove, Cantaloupe, Spearmint & Turmeric Pressed Cooler
recipes.summary: Refreshing golden melon press combining chilled clove infusion, sweet cantaloupe, cooling spearmint, turmeric, and a tiny crack of black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 3 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep whole cloves in 1/2 cup hot water 3 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled clove tea, cantaloupe cubes, spearmint leaves, turmeric, and a tiny pinch of black pepper 30 seconds.
Press smoothly through a fine sieve and serve chilled.
tips: Cantaloupe mellows warm clove and turmeric into an effortless hydrating glass.
Crisp mint finish.

recipes.title: Velvet Clove, Barley Water, Blueberry & Fresh Shiso Press
recipes.summary: Silky purple botanical tonic uniting chilled strained barley water, mild clove tea, pressed blueberries, and fragrant shiso.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 3 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep whole cloves in 1/3 cup hot water 3 minutes, strain, and chill.
Blend fresh blueberries, orange juice, shiso leaves, and chilled clove tea 30 seconds, then press through a fine sieve.
Stir smoothly into chilled barley water and serve cold.
tips: Barley water adds velvety smoothness to spiced berry juice.
Refreshing and fiber-free.
